childReport.diffSummary: Security audit of all foundation-layer code in backend/ and frontend/. No files modified — read-only audit.
reviewFindings: blocker: backend/app/core/config.py:17,22,35 - Hardcoded JWT secret, database credentials, and admin API key in source code defaults
blocker: backend/app/main.py:67 - Information disclosure: error_type exposes Python exception class names to clients
blocker: backend/app/api/profile.py:16-33 - No JWT authentication middleware exists; protected endpoints are stubs with no auth checks
high: frontend/src/stores/authStore.ts:22-23 - JWT tokens stored in localStorage (XSS-vulnerable); httpOnly cookie intent not implemented
high: backend/app/api/auth.py:42-87 - No rate limiting on /login, /register, /refresh endpoints
high: backend/app/main.py:27-42 - Missing security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Cache-Control) on API responses
high: backend/app/api/quiz.py:98-99 - Quiz answer correctness leaked in API response (answer oracle)
childReport.manualNotes: This is a foundation-phase audit. Many findings are expected for skeleton code (e.g., missing auth middleware). The most urgent item is the hardcoded secrets in config.py which must be resolved before any deployment. The frontend localStorage token pattern contradicts the axios withCredentials:true intent — the team should decide on cookie-based vs. header-based auth and implement it consistently.
